title: Better Navigation
description: I created this mod that player, no longer to press F3 to navigate preventing to ruining of their exploration experiences.
body:
Are you tired to press F3 of your keyboard? Well same here, and now I've decided to solve my problem to share all of you what I create.

And this is Better Navigation...
It is simple HUD that no longer to navigate your coordinates, days, on your F3 Keyboard.

**Features:
Last Death Position (Press H on your keyboard or customized your own keybinds)
Linear Compass
Stats HUD (Coords, Day, FPS)**

_Official Released in All Version 1.21.X (Fabric API required of specific version.

Coming Soon the Snapshot 26.x on June 15_

Let me know if there's the bug or not working for you and contact me on discord:
https://discord.com/channels/1513463083492708515/1513463084134563993
